- Public files: the North digests and notes. Brackenwater only comes up in the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest, which says the account moved to Marcus on 15 Sep 2025. It lists open questions about the yard map and door 6, but nothing about renewal.
- Account files: the share has no Brackenwater contract or CRM files that he can see.

I suggested he ask June Osei-Lark on the deal desk, in case the date was agreed on a call or by email.
